newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian auto investment important - Japan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian auto investment important - Japan.

text.p: Japan's Ambassador to Australia on Monday entered the debate on the Australian automotive industry, saying Japanese investment in the sector was very important but that tariffs were not the only critical factor.

"I regard the Japanese investment in (Australia's automotive industry) is very important for this country's economy and for our relations", Yukio Satoh told reporters after the launch of an Australian-Japanese joint venture here.
With automotive tariffs due to drop to 15 percent by 2000, the Australian industry is calling for a five year freeze on further cuts.
However, a Federal government Productivity Commission has proposed dropping tariffs to five percent by 2004.
Car manufacturers have called for microeconomic support, such as labour market and taxation reform, in response to major industry rationalisation over the last decade.
Satoh said no country was opposed to the reduction of tariffs.
"But my interest is how to assure the development of the automotive industry and for that there are many aspects and tariffs are only one aspect," he said.
